items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: Warner used to come to my house all the time to see about it.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear your husband say anything about making a record with that band?

Never did. Never did. But I guess if he lived, he would have. Yeah, because he had good opportunity. If he lived, he'd have made records. It was a good band, I'm telling you. Warner and all of them can tell you. Y'all say you've been to Warner. Warner played with him a long time too. I don't know how long, but Warner was playing with him. Warner was playing with him when he fell sick. But Warner used to come to my house all the time to see about it.
Did you ever know King Oliver by any chance?
